title: Teaching Practice
modules: Qualities And Skills Expected Of Student
Roles Of Different Stakeholders In Noun'S
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the ultimate beneficiaries of the teaching practice exercise."
Student-teachers are the ultimate beneficiaries of the teaching practice exercise.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the assessment and judgment of the student-teacher's performance during and at the end of the teaching practice."
Evaluation refers to the assessment and judgment of the student-teacher's performance during and at the end of the teaching practice.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the Heads of Primary Schools or Principals of Secondary Schools or the Heads of Departments of specific subject areas in cooperating schools."
Head Teachers are the Heads of Primary Schools or Principals of Secondary Schools or the Heads of Departments of specific subject areas in cooperating schools.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the initiator of the Teaching Practice."
NOUN is the initiator of the Teaching Practice.
fib: ______ is a compulsory requirement for the completion of any certificate, diploma or degree in Teacher Education Programme in Nigeria.
A successful participation in SIP is a compulsory requirement for the completion of any certificate, diploma or degree in Teacher Education Programme in Nigeria.
______ are the schools where the student-teachers will be undertaking their teaching practice exercise.
Cooperating Schools are the schools where the student-teachers will be undertaking their teaching practice exercise.
______ is the core of teaching practice exercise.
Supervision is the core of teaching practice exercise.
______ are the subject teachers in the cooperating schools who serve as mentors to student-teachers assigned to their classes.
Cooperating Teachers are the subject teachers in the cooperating schools who serve as mentors to student-teachers assigned to their classes.
